title: Memory backends: /changes intermediate states over maxChanges
description: RFC 8620 §5.2 (rfc8620.txt L1763-1766): over maxChanges the server SHOULD generate an update to an intermediate state (hasMoreChanges=true). The chat, contacts, graph and vtc MemoryBackend get_changes return BackendChangesError::TooManyChanges instead, which after JMAP-a01c surfaces as cannotCalculateChanges and forces a full client resync. Implement truncation to maxChanges with an intermediate newState and has_more_changes=true. Follow-up from JMAP-a01c.
